missions.title: Old Lilas kleine Werkstatt
missions.objective: Choose what to make for a little room; match a wooden chair, a glass windowpane and a brick wall to pictured materials; small visible sums (5 + 2, 8 − 2), then ten-bundles (20 + 1) with a fresh check (20 + 3) and an easier path only when needed; read one word with pictures (AST) and switch to supported letter learning if needed; recognise a spoken German instruction by picture; a real-world craft and three wooden things at home; her room and a pictured next-interest choice.

theme.note: The theme follows the parent's planning inputs (kept in the private project record, not in this file); they are not her own saved choice and not assessed mastery. Her own choice is asked at the end.
